suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out on a Friday and didn't blow up over the weekend.
I'm thankful for the mamak still being open when the standup ran late and nobody had lunch yet.
I'm grateful for finally figuring out why the staging environment was lying to me for three days straight.
I'm thankful for the sound of rain on the window right as I'm closing the laptop for the night.
I'm grateful for a teammate who reviewed my PR and actually left useful comments instead of just approving it.
I'm thankful for the ten minutes before Fajr when the whole block is dead quiet and the mind finally settles.
I'm grateful for a teh tarik that hit exactly right after a meeting that went nowhere.
I'm thankful for my mom calling just to ask if I've eaten, even though I'm thirty minutes from done with work.
I'm grateful for a stack trace that actually pointed at the real problem for once.
I'm thankful for having a job that pays on time every month, rezeki I don't take for granted.
I'm grateful for the office aircon finally getting fixed after weeks of sweating through code reviews.
I'm thankful for a Friday khutbah short enough that I still made it back before the parking ran out.
I'm grateful for a junior who asked a question that made me realize I didn't actually understand the system either.
I'm thankful for leftover rendang reheating better than the first time it was cooked.
I'm grateful for a long weekend where the only thing on my laptop was a game, not a terminal.
